There is no better day than #NationalVoterRegistrationDay to exercise a right that so many like Mr. Lewis have fought and sacrificed for.

Make sure to check your voter registration status and register today if you aren’t already! Visit: https://t.co/XItjfQzz2X

Today, on Overdose Awareness Day, we remember those we've lost and renew our commitment to fighting the opioid crisis. So far in 2024, New Jersey has seen 1,322 overdose deaths. It’s crucial we enhance prevention, treatment, and support for those affected. Together, we can build a future where recovery is possible for everyone.💜

Nobody elected Elon Musk yet Donald Trump has handed him the keys to the federal government. That’s unacceptable. 

That’s why I joined my colleagues today at the Treasury Department to exercise our oversight authority.

Democrats are in this fight because you have sent us here to fight and that’s exactly what we will do.

❌ Gutting healthcare programs that’ll leave 13.7 million people without coverage

❌ Slashing funding for grants to address air pollution at schools

❌ Giving away Americans’ sensitive data to big tech and foreign adversaries

Republicans think they’re fooling the American people when they say they’re “shifting” people off Medicaid when we all know people are losing healthcare coverage under this bill.

We’re not buying it, and neither should you.

[Time stamp: 2:39 AM] https://t.co/WjHChmuZGj

After over 26 consecutive hours, @EnergyCommerce Democrats fought throughout the night to protect Medicaid and other vital programs from extreme Republican cuts that would impact every American.

Here are my thoughts after finally catching up on (some) sleep. 🧵 https://t.co/JgBFMMBkF3

It’s not just 13.7 million losing healthcare under the Republican tax bill—over 900,000 people would lose SNAP benefits as well. 

Cuts to healthcare and nutrition assistance programs, all to fund tax cuts for those who need them the least. It’s shameful.

Republicans are trying to quietly gut ACA coverage, kicking millions more off health care to pay for tax breaks for the richest amongst us. 
https://t.co/ccfnQw3z12

While they're not calling it a repeal (publicly, at least), the result is the same: less coverage, more people pushed to the brink. 

We won’t let them get away with it - and neither should you.

I was proud to stand with @FrankPallone and our @EnergyCommerce colleagues to fight against GOP cuts to the healthcare that so many New Jerseyans rely on. 

Meanwhile Tom Kean stayed silent and voted to advance a bill that could strip coverage from thousands of his constituents. 

Read our full op-ed below ⬇️

https://t.co/fvV5GySQ9n

🚨Senate Republicans are caving to Trump’s pressure—here’s what their disastrous bill does: 

☑️ Slashes Medicaid and health coverage for almost 12 million people
☑️ Adds nearly $4 trillion to our national debt
☑️ Hands tax breaks to those who need it the least
☑️ Does nothing to lower costs for working families 

It’s a giveaway to the top 0.01% —on the backs of the majority of Americans.

Let’s be clear: when people lose healthcare coverage, the costs don’t just disappear—they shift. 

I’m fighting to protect coverage and strengthen care for all of our constituents after Republicans’ disastrous cuts. https://t.co/r0Q2tuTDx0

We know that school meals and other nutrition programs, like SNAP, are essential. Apparently, Republicans do not. 

That’s why I joined @RepLaMonica’s School Meals Roundtable to discuss how we can protect these vital programs - together. https://t.co/FW8FNopf9Y

Before House Republicans passed the OBBB, healthcare providers and patients were sounding the alarms on the harm the bill would cause. We listened, we voted against it. House Republicans? Not so much. 

Watch below and click the link in our bio to listen to the full episode. https://t.co/QrwDOb85nV

Had an important conversation with @ChildrensPhila about their vital work advancing children’s health research and innovation. 

As Republicans slash healthcare, it’s critical to uplift our doctors, nurses, and hospitals on the frontlines—and support their plans to increase patient access.

Before @BarackObama signed the ACA into law 13 years ago, many New Jerseyans had no access to affordable health insurance.

Now, at least 75,000 New Jerseyans could lose their coverage if Republicans let ACA tax credits expire and healthcare would be more expensive for so many friends and neighbors across our state.  
 
@HouseDemocrats are fighting every day to protect and extend this life-changing law for our communities. 

https://t.co/ZNWWzhu3NB

If Republicans let ACA tax credits expire, countless families across our communities will lose their coverage–and healthcare costs will skyrocket for our friends and neighbors across New Jersey.

@HouseDemocrats are fighting every single day to protect affordable coverage and save lives.

No one should risk their health & safety to see a loved one. 

That's why I joined @DonaldNorcross in calling out @DHSgov & the GEO Group for their treatment of families visiting Delaney Hall - and demanding change. These unsafe conditions show a profound disregard for dignity & basic rights.

Republicans have no real healthcare plan - just cuts.

As millions face higher premiums, the GOP offers ZERO alternative to lower costs or expand coverage. Their strategy? Slash programs and make families pay the price.

Meanwhile, @HouseDemocrats are working to protect healthcare--just as we've done before. 

https://t.co/qrp8V95JBk

We are in day 3 of a government shutdown and the president is nowhere to be found.

Anyone doing a wellness check?

📍@NorthHudsonCAC in @OfficialUCNJ 

📢 While Republicans work to cut Medicaid & make it harder for Americans to have access to affordable care, it's critical we stand up for our Federally Qualified Health Centers & protect the essential services millions rely on. 

I look forward to continuing to support them & the incredible work they do in @HudCoTweet and beyond.

1️⃣ After cutting a trillion dollars from healthcare in our country, Republicans are set on letting ACA tax credits expire. Because of their actions (and inaction), premiums are going to go up across the country.

Their plan? Keep the government shutdown so they aren’t here to be held accountable.

Republicans have already made the largest cuts to Medicaid in the program’s history & now they’re refusing to extend the ACA tax credits, raising health insurance premiums for families across the country.

@HouseDemocrats are holding the line in the fight to protect healthcare for all Americans.
